newsitem.title: USA: Midland says Permian drill test positive.
newsitem.headline: Midland says Permian drill test positive.

text.p: Midland Resources Inc said Thursday its exploratory well drilling project in the Chalk Mountain in the Permian Basin in West Texas has indicated positive results.
It said it reached total depth on a 9,500 foot Fusselman exploratory well and tests had indicated hydrocarbons.

Deas H. Warley, president and chief executive of the company said, "Although a drill stem test and open hole logs indicate the presence of hydrocarbons and good porosity within the target formation, it will not be until the well is completed and thoroughly tested that the company can assess the potential economic impact to the company or assess possible additional drilling potential in the project area."

Warley said that existing shareholders and anyone considering buying the company's shares or warrants should carefully consider the inherent risks in the oil and gas industry and especially those associated with exploratory drilling.
Midland Resources is a natural gas and oil company with interests principally in the Permian Basin of West Texas, the Texas Gulf Coast, and the Colorado DJ Basin.
